text_simplified: The Muslim woman is distinguished by modest, covering attire, and the Prophet ﷺ warned against immodest dress when he mentioned: "women who are clothed yet naked" and stated that they "will not enter Paradise, nor will they find its fragrance" (Sahih Muslim 2128); Ibn Taymiyyah (may Allah have mercy on him) explained that "clothed yet naked" refers to wearing garments that are transparent, short, or tight. Shaykh Ibn Baz (may Allah have mercy on him) emphasized that it is not permissible to be lax in dressing young girls in short clothes, because raising them upon that leads them to grow accustomed to it when they get older.
